automatic_root_source: The object-root proposal stored by the original Grounded-SAM2/SAM2 inference run; no reference mask is used in this condition.

perturbation_protocol.translation: 2% of crop diagonal in a deterministic direction

upper_bound_scope: The reference-root condition intentionally uses the PACO object mask and is reported only as an oracle upper-bound diagnostic.
remaining_oracle_scope: All cases remain object crops produced from reference bounding boxes; this audit does not test full-image object discovery.
